title: Listening as a Lost Skill
sentences: Music has become almost impossible to avoid and correspondingly easy to ignore.
It accompanies shopping, waiting, exercising and working.
In each case it is doing something other than being listened to.
Attention given to a piece from beginning to end is now faintly unusual.
The recording industry did not conspire to bring this about.
It simply became cheaper to have music everywhere than anywhere in particular.
Abundance has a way of converting an occasion into a background.
The loss is difficult to articulate because nothing was taken away.
Everything remains available, which is exactly the mechanism.
What has become scarce is not the music but the silence that framed it.
